question: How should participants be selected for the body-circle when no prior arrangement exists?
premises: Participants may be engaged without prior arrangement.
They are identified through the recitation of deity names.
If the body-circle cannot be formed, one should worship maidens only.
inference: The body-circle may be formed spontaneously through deity-name recitation, but if that is not possible, the rite should be performed by worshipping maidens alone.
uncertainties: The practical method by which deity-name recitation selects participants.
plain_english: Those not joined by prior arrangement should be engaged through the recitation of deity names. If the body-circle cannot be obtained, one should worship maidens only.
